# OCKLU AIRANK — AI Visibility Index

> Live measurement of which brands AI answer engines name when buyers ask.
> Every figure is backed by the stored raw model answer, the engine used and the timestamp.
> Absence from a board means the brand was not named in those calls — not that it is never named.

## Boards
- [AI visibility tool](https://ocklu.com/airank/index/ai-visibility-tool.html): which brands AI engines named for AI visibility tool buyer questions, 4 live calls, updated 2026-09-22
- [CRM for small business](https://ocklu.com/airank/index/crm-for-small-business.html): which brands AI engines named for CRM for small business buyer questions, 3 live calls, updated 2026-09-21
- [SEO agency](https://ocklu.com/airank/index/seo-agency.html): which brands AI engines named for SEO agency buyer questions, 6 live calls, updated 2026-09-21
- [social media marketing agency](https://ocklu.com/airank/index/social-media-marketing-agency.html): which brands AI engines named for social media marketing agency buyer questions, 3 live calls, updated 2026-09-22

## Switching from another tool
Side-by-side pricing and measured visibility for the tools people compare us with:
https://ocklu.com/airank/vs/ (otterly.ai, peec.ai, tryprofound.com, semrush.com,
ahrefs.com, brightedge.com, conductor.com, wordlift.io)

## Open method and raw data
Method, scoring and stated limits: https://ocklu.com/airank/method.html
Raw evidence per board as JSON: https://ocklu.com/airank/data/<board>.json
Per-brand evidence pages: https://ocklu.com/airank/u/<domain>.html

## Method
Unbranded buyer questions are fired at AI answer engines (web-search grounded and
memory-only). Mentions, position and cited domains are extracted from the raw answer.
Failed calls are recorded as failures and never counted as "not mentioned".
